title: UPESSC UP TGT Recruitment 2026
summary: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission UPESSC , has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of Assistant Teacher (Trained Graduate Grade) Posts. This recruitment is for 17,735 positions. UPESSC Application Form has started on 24 October 2026 & the candidates can apply until the 23 November 2026 . Minimum age is 21 Years & The Maximum Age Is 62 Years as on 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPESSC UP TGT Recruitment 2026. Link are given below. ( Advt. No. 07/2026 )
category_wise_vacancies: How To Fill UPESSC UP TGT Online Form 2026

Interested candidates who wish to apply for the UPESSC post can submit their application online before 23 November 2026. Use the click here link provided below under important link section to apply directly. Alternatively, visit the official website of UPESSC to complete the application process online. Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 23 November 2026 .
